name: Intuit QuickBooks Online

verdict.headline: Sandbox keys are available right away, but production keys need an App Details form plus an App Assessment Questionnaire that Intuit must approve, with no stated review time.
verdict.nextAction: Create an Intuit Developer account and app, build and test connect/disconnect/reconnect against the sandbox, then fill in Production > App Details and start the questionnaire.

paths.name: Production keys (unlisted)
paths.whenThisApplies: You need production Client ID and secret to connect real QuickBooks companies, including private or internal apps, without a QuickBooks App Store listing.

timeline.label: Account, app, sandbox and OAuth flow
timeline.note: Hours to 1–2 days of build work. Our estimate; no official figure.

timeline.label: App Assessment Questionnaire
timeline.note: No stated length from Intuit. Codat says roughly 30 minutes.

timeline.label: Intuit questionnaire approval
timeline.note: No review time stated for questionnaire approval.

paths.name: Intuit App Store listing
paths.whenThisApplies: Optional. You want the app listed on the QuickBooks App Store. A separate, much heavier 3-part review (technical, security, marketing).

timeline.label: Intuit emails to set up a call
timeline.note: Within 2 business days. Intuit says these are "estimates only".

timeline.label: Security review
timeline.note: Up to 30 business days. Intuit says "estimates only".

timeline.label: Marketing review
timeline.note: Intuit says "estimates only". Total is about 9–10 weeks before any fixes.

timeline.label: Fixing review findings
timeline.note: All critical, high and medium security findings must be fixed. No stated time for re-review.

beforeApproval.item: Development keys work with sandbox companies only
beforeApproval.detail: Production Client ID and secret are accessible only after the Production Key questionnaire is approved.

beforeApproval.item: A US sandbox company is created automatically
beforeApproval.detail: Up to 10 sandboxes, each lasting 2 years.
No payroll, live bank feeds, or import/export. Sample data can't be reset. Region and SKU are fixed once created. 40 emails per day.

beforeApproval.item: Localhost over plain HTTP is allowed for Development redirect URIs only
beforeApproval.detail: Production redirect URIs must be HTTPS and cannot be IP addresses.

beforeApproval.item: Sandbox calls are not metered under the App Partner Program
Partner Program tier eligibility requires an approved questionnaire

prerequisites.item: Intuit Developer account with a workspace and verified email
prerequisites.detail: Review My Hub > Account Profile and verify your email before starting the questionnaire.

prerequisites.item: Hosted EULA and Privacy Policy URLs
prerequisites.detail: Required fields in Production > App Details.
Comes before Production > Compliance > Start Questionnaire.

prerequisites.item: App Store listing: a valid SaaS domain

steps.title: Create an Intuit Developer account and workspace
steps.detail: Sign up, accept the Developer Terms, and create a workspace with basic company info.

steps.title: Create the app and choose scopes
steps.detail: My Hub > App dashboard > "+". Scopes: com.intuit.quickbooks.accounting, com.intuit.quickbooks.payment, openid (plus profile/email/phone/address). Scopes can be added later but never removed; users must re-authorize when scopes change.
steps.agentHelp: List the minimum scopes the app needs, since scopes can't be removed later.

steps.title: Copy Development credentials
steps.detail: Keys and credentials > Development > Show credentials. These keys work with sandbox companies only. A US sandbox company is created automatically.

steps.title: Set Development redirect URIs
steps.detail: Localhost over plain HTTP is allowed here. The URI must match exactly, and you must click Save.
steps.agentHelp: Check that redirect URIs match the app's callback exactly.

steps.title: Build and test the OAuth flow against the sandbox
steps.detail: Test connect, disconnect and reconnect. Handle refresh-token rotation (store the newest value from every response), a reconnect flow, and intuit_tid logging. The OAuth 2.0 Playground is fine for quick checks.

steps.title: Draft EULA and privacy policy text
steps.detail: Needed for the EULA URL and Privacy Policy URL fields in App Details.

steps.title: Host the EULA and privacy pages on a real domain
steps.detail: Forum answers say a placeholder URL is accepted for apps you use yourself.
steps.agentHelp: Draft the page text and check the URLs are HTTPS.

steps.title: Fill in Production > App Details
steps.detail: Contact email, EULA URL, Privacy Policy URL, host domain, launch URL, disconnect URL, connect/reconnect URL, up to 4 categories, regulated industries, hosting regions. About 30 minutes.
steps.agentHelp: Prepare the value for each field in a checklist.

steps.title: Review account profile and verify email
Draft questionnaire answers
steps.detail: Cover app info, auth, API usage, Accounting API, error handling and security sections.

steps.title: Submit the App Assessment Questionnaire
steps.detail: Production > Compliance > Start Questionnaire, then submit. Answer truthfully, especially the security and breach questions.
steps.agentHelp: Prepare draft answers for each section for you to review.

steps.title: Copy production credentials and set production redirect URIs
steps.detail: After approval the "Show Credentials" switch appears under Production. Copy the production Client ID and secret, and set HTTPS production redirect URIs (no IP addresses).
steps.agentHelp: Check that production redirect URIs are HTTPS and match exactly.

steps.title: Add a payment method if moving to Silver
steps.detail: Only if you need more than the Builder tier's 500K CorePlus calls per month.

steps.title: Optional: take the App Store setup call and handle security-scan correspondence
steps.detail: Intuit emails within 2 business days to set up a call.
steps.agentHelp: Prepare a checklist against the technical and security requirements.

steps.title: Optional: Intuit's 3-part App Store review
steps.detail: Technical review 10 business days, security review up to 30 business days, marketing review 5 business days. Estimates only.

submissionChecklist.detail: Contact email, EULA URL, Privacy Policy URL, host domain, launch URL, disconnect URL, connect/reconnect URL, up to 4 categories, regulated industries, hosting regions.
How the app was built, platforms, public or private, user types.
Whether you tested connect/disconnect/reconnect, how often you refresh tokens, retries, how you handle invalid_grant and CSRF, whether you use the discovery document.
Versions supported, multi-currency, sales tax, webhooks, CDC.
Capturing intuit_tid, logging, in-app support contact.
Past breaches, a security team, storage of the secret, MFA, captcha, who can access the data.
Appears only if you flag the app as a lender.
Connect to QuickBooks and Sign in with Intuit buttons, an emailVerified check, a disconnect action that calls revoke, multi-company support for accountant apps, and Intuit-approved logos.
All critical, high and medium security findings fixed. HTTPS everywhere, TLS 1.2 recommended, Secure and HttpOnly cookies.

submissionChecklist.item: App Store listing: industry review for regulated apps
submissionChecklist.detail: Lending, insurance, investment and payments apps go through an extra industry review.

gotchas.title: Refresh tokens rotate about every 24 hours
gotchas.detail: Store the newest refresh token from every response, because the old one stops working. Refresh tokens expire after 100 days unused (rolling), with a 5-year hard maximum (Feb 2026 release notes). Access tokens last 1 hour.

gotchas.title: First 5-year refresh-token expiries are coming
gotchas.detail: Reported for Feb 2027 (granular scopes) and Oct 2028 (accounting/payments). Build a reconnect flow now. A Reconnect URL field was added to the portal in Feb 2026.

gotchas.title: Builder tier blocks read calls above 500K per month
gotchas.detail: The App Partner Program (US since 2025-07-28; UK/AU/CA from 2025-11-03) puts every app on the free Builder tier, with no opt-out. It is capped at 500K CorePlus (read) calls per month, and calls above the cap are blocked, not billed. Core (write) calls and sandbox calls are not metered. Quebec is excluded.

gotchas.title: Silver tier costs money
gotchas.detail: $300/month (US example), includes 1M calls, then $3.50 per 1K. Tier eligibility requires an approved questionnaire.

gotchas.title: Rate limits
gotchas.detail: 500 requests per minute per realm, 10 per second per realm and app, and 40 batch requests per minute. A 429 means wait 60 seconds.

gotchas.title: Throttling below the documented limits
gotchas.detail: Forum users report hitting throttles below the documented rate limits.

gotchas.title: Scopes can't be removed
gotchas.detail: Scopes can be added later but never removed, and users must re-authorize when scopes change.

gotchas.title: Private and internal apps still need the questionnaire
gotchas.detail: Intuit support says production keys require questionnaire approval even for private or internal apps.

gotchas.title: Placeholder EULA and privacy URLs
gotchas.detail: Forum answers say a placeholder EULA or privacy URL is accepted for apps you use yourself.

gotchas.title: Approved apps can still fail to connect
gotchas.detail: June–July 2026 forum threads describe apps approved for production that still fail with "undefined didn't connect" or route to sandbox companies. No official fix has been posted.

gotchas.title: Redirect URI never saved
gotchas.detail: A common cause of redirect_uri errors is a redirect URI that was never saved. The URI must match exactly, and you must click Save.

gotchas.title: Listed apps have ongoing compliance duties
gotchas.detail: There is an annual compliance review, and the security affidavit is due within 2 weeks of Intuit's request.

blockers.symptom: No production Client ID or secret visible
blockers.whatToDo: Complete App Details and the App Assessment Questionnaire; the "Show Credentials" switch under Production appears only after approval.
Check the redirect URI matches exactly, is HTTPS for production with no IP address, and that you clicked Save.

blockers.symptom: Approved app fails with "undefined didn't connect" or routes to sandbox companies
blockers.whatToDo: No official fix has been posted. Open a support case with your App ID, intuit_tid and the authorization URL.
blockers.contact: Support case from the developer portal

blockers.symptom: Read calls blocked after 500K in a month
blockers.whatToDo: Builder tier cap reached. Move to Silver (requires an approved questionnaire and a payment method).
